description: Copy of the shared kamodigi Renovate preset (a public repository cannot read the private preset). Keep it in sync with the shared preset; add repository-specific rules after the copied ones.

packageRules.description: Group npm minor and patch updates into one PR
Group GitHub Actions updates into one PR
eslint and @eslint/* (js, compat) bump majors together; keep them in one PR, majors included
@sveltejs/* and vite only build when their versions match; keep them in one PR, majors included
